body.title: Docs, the ac6 matrix and the s7 requirement
body.summary: Update docs/daemon.md with the approval exchange, the tools.commonApproval setting, the class mapping and the retirement of permissions.mode; add the mode x tool-class matrix test that pins the DEF ac6 reading across the real executor and broker; record in docs/plans/tool-registry.md what s7 must build against (the tool-call IPC carries caller and optional approvalMode, and a chat sends its session's PermissionMode as approvalMode).
acceptanceChecks: docs/daemon.md describes the exchange, the setting and the class mapping
the matrix test asserts the ask rule for every mode against none, common and destructive tools through the real executor and broker
docs/plans/tool-registry.md states what s7 must build against

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/__tests__/approval-matrix.test.ts: every mode against none, common and destructive tools asks exactly as the ac6 reading says, through the real executor and broker
